name: Exp_2pbIdealMA
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system based on two custom indicators (2pbIdeal1MA and 2pbIdeal3MA) to generate buy and sell signals. It opens positions when the faster 1-MA crosses above/below the slower 3-MA, and closes positions on the reverse crossover. Position sizing is controlled by a flexible money management parameter that supports either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based allocation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于两个自定义指标(2pbIdeal1MA和2pbIdeal3MA)的双重均线交叉系统来产生买卖信号。当快速的1-MA向上/向下穿越慢速的3-MA时开仓，反向交叉时平仓。仓位管理通过灵活的资金管理参数支持固定手数或按比例分配。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于自定义理想移动平均线的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当2pbIdeal1MA从下方穿越2pbIdeal3MA时产生买入信号，从上方穿越时产生卖出信号，这是典型的双均线交叉趋势跟踪逻辑。出场条件包括反向均线交叉平仓以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算仓位大小。EA在每个新K线出现时检测信号，避免逐tick重复交易，这是一种合理的信号过滤方式。策略使用了三层平滑的理想移动平均线（3MA指标），通过多级粗调和精调平滑减少假信号，但所有周期参数均设为10，缺乏差异化配置。资金管理参数允许较大的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)，风险收益比为1:2，但在高波动市场中止损可能不足。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy based on custom ideal moving average indicators. Entry conditions are triggered when 2pbIdeal1MA crosses above 2pbIdeal3MA for buy signals and below for sell signals, representing a classic dual MA crossover trend-following logic. Exit conditions include reverse MA crossover position closure along with fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional allocation. The EA detects signals on each new bar rather than every tick, which is a sensible approach to avoid duplicate trades and reduce noise. The strategy uses a triple-smoothed ideal moving average (3MA indicator) with multi-level rough and fine smoothing to reduce false signals, but all period parameters default to 10, lacking differentiated configuration. The money management allows a large stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, though the stop loss may be insufficient in highly volatile markets.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数，正值为比例
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio; negative value=fixed lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号和频繁交易，逻辑清晰合理
提供买入/卖出开仓和平仓的独立开关，灵活控制交易方向
采用多级平滑的理想移动平均线减少假信号，比简单均线交叉更稳定
风险收益比1:2设计合理，止盈大于止损符合趋势跟踪策略特征
包含数据就绪检查和历史加载机制，运行稳健性较好
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism avoids duplicate signals and excessive trading, with clear and sensible logic
Independent toggle switches for buy/sell opening and closing provide flexible directional control
Multi-level smoothed ideal moving averages reduce false signals compared to simple MA crossovers
1:2 risk-reward ratio is well-designed with take profit exceeding stop loss, fitting trend-following strategy characteristics
Includes data readiness checks and history loading mechanism for better operational robustness
cons: 所有平滑周期参数默认值均为10，缺乏差异化，3MA指标的三层平滑实际效果可能等同于单层
均线交叉策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
没有移动止盈或追踪止损机制，趋势行情中可能过早平仓无法充分获利
没有交易时间过滤、点差过滤和市场状态检测，在不利条件下仍会开仓
依赖外部自定义指标文件(2pbIdeal1MA/2pbIdeal3MA)，部署和移植不便
cons_en: All smoothing period parameters default to 10 with no differentiation, the 3MA triple smoothing may effectively behave like single smoothing
MA crossover strategies generate frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
No trailing stop or break-even mechanism, potentially exiting too early in strong trends and not capturing full profit
No trading session filter, spread filter, or market state detection, allowing entries under unfavorable conditions
Depends on external custom indicator files (2pbIdeal1MA/2pbIdeal3MA), making deployment and migration inconvenient
improvements: 为3MA指标的各层平滑设置差异化默认周期，避免三层平滑效果趋同
增加移动止盈/追踪止损机制，在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润并延长持仓时间
添加震荡市过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在无明显趋势时暂停交易减少假信号亏损
improvements_en: Set differentiated default periods for each smoothing layer of the 3MA indicator to avoid convergent triple smoothing effects
Add trailing stop or break-even mechanism to lock in floating profits and extend holding time during strong trends
Add a ranging market filter (such as ADX or ATR) to pause trading during trendless periods and reduce false signal losses

risk_points: 均线交叉在震荡市中会产生大量虚假信号导致连续小额亏损
固定止损1000点在极端行情下可能不足，缺乏波动率自适应机制
无点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在低流动性或高滑点时段开仓
risk_points_en: MA crossovers generate numerous false signals in ranging markets causing consecutive small losses
Fixed 1000-point stop loss may be insufficient during extreme market moves, lacking volatility-adaptive mechanism
No spread or trading session filters, potentially opening positions during low liquidity or high slippage periods
